_comment: I0 provider playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). Public facts only, every claim sourced; LOW confidence throughout: rainbet.com refused automated reads (HTTP 403), so the facts come from search snippets of its own pages and from secondary sources. No law-enforcement channel is published: rainbet.le stays null. A compliance alias without a public source is never catalogued.
notes: Custodial crypto casino, so it can restrict, freeze or close accounts: its terms ask for KYC documents with 72 hours to respond, verification can take up to 7 business days, and failed KYC or falsified documents lead to closure and forfeiture. Sources disagree on the operator: the AML page names RBGAMING N.V. with a Curacao office, a review names an Anjouan licence and a different company name. The Comoros government calls the Anjouan licensing bodies fictitious, so a regulator complaint is weak.

entities.name: RBGAMING N.V. (named as operator on the AML page)
entities.notes: Registration and licence details conflict between sources (Curacao office vs Anjouan licence).

channels.label: Support desk (named on the AML and responsible-gambling pages for AML / KYC enquiries)
channels.notes: A 'support' alias on rainbet.com, seen only in search snippets of the AML page (the site refused automated reads): not a catalogue local part, so add it as a case channel after checking the page in a browser. Complaints escalate to a Compliance Manager (unconfirmed).

rainbet.le.notes: No law-enforcement channel is published. Leave null.

instrument.notes: A courtesy request; cite the police / IC3 reference.

paths.notes: Ask for a risk-control hold on the account that received the funds and preservation of its KYC and transaction records. No third-party victim process is published: any hold is discretionary. The site uses Elliptic screening and keeps KYC records 10 years after closure (snippets).
Undocumented: no LE process is published. The AML policy says the AML compliance officer files a suspicious activity report with the relevant FIU where necessary (snippet).
